theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (-0.66%) and Financials (-1.37%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-2.86%) and Technology (-2.19%) brought up the rear. That split lines up with a rotation out of growth: growth-oriented sectors averaged -2.33% versus -1.60% for defensives and -1.35% for value and cyclicals, suggesting money moved from high-multiple names into steadier, cash-generative businesses. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -1.61%, Dow -1.87%, Nasdaq -1.72% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at -1.52%. The VIX rose 10.42% to 27.12, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 1.26% to $3,677.30, crude oil was little changed at $82.68, and bitcoin slipped 1.00% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
